Marissa / Tessa — introducing you both to Naviga Health (Liam / Priya). We closed the deal this morning and need CS/Implementation to run the kickoff and the security pre-call. Summary / notes below so you have the highlights for handoff: 

Deal summary (quick): 
- SKU: Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated burst pool for ingest pipeline
- Expected QPS: steady 120 qps with 3-minute peaks up to 350 qps
- Primary success metric: 95th percentile latency <= 220ms; pilot acceptance tied to a set of 8 prompt-level accuracy checks in the SOW
- Contract: 12 months, annual billing; deal id HSP-98431

Key risks / attention items: 
- Networking: customer uses a private VPC with strict egress rules — Priya will coordinate firewall rules.
- Data handling: customer wants a 30-day rolling retention for logs; confirm we can map to their retention policy (SOW notes 30 days by default).
- Rollback thresholds: outlined in SOW appendix — need to agree exact tolerances and who signs off during the pilot.

What I recommend for the first week of engagement: 
1) Security pre-call (30–45m) — June 2 at 10:00am PT (Priya and our infra lead)
2) 90-min kickoff — June 8 at 9:00am PT: agenda defined (introduction, success metrics, rollout plan, roles, blockers)
3) Add the following action owners in the kickoff invite:
   - Marissa Cole — CS owner (post-sale success, acceptance criteria)
   - Tessa Morgan — Implementation lead (networking, staging, go-live plan)
   - Ben Carter — Sales contact (escalation on commercial questions)

Attached: relevant SOW pages called out (see page numbers 2, 6, 9). Contracts team — DocuSign request is live; please ping when signed so we can finalize calendar invites.

Thanks — please take ownership of the kickoff scheduling and the security pre-call. Loop me on any escalation.

Ben
